terms.description:
Description:
 Type of charge point providing slower charging speeds, typically used in home, workplace, or public locations.
terms.usageRules: Always write “AC” in uppercase. Use in full expressions such as “AC charge point” for clarity. Do not translate the acronym in localized content. Avoid using “alternating current” unless in technical or educational documentation. Acceptable in both UI and documentation when describing charger type or specifications.

terms.description: The organizational unit within an Operator that groups members, EVSEs, wallet, and settings under one entity. Formerly displayed as "Team" across all product surfaces.
terms.usageRules: Always lowercase in running text ("create an account", "invite members to your account"). Capitalise only as a standalone UI label or heading ("Accounts", "Account settings"). Do not use "team" to refer to this entity in new copy — "account" is the canonical term. Do not confuse with "profile" (personal user identity) or "operator" (the parent business entity).

terms.description: Description: An extra fee added to a price group by a Team Owner to adjust session pricing. Examples include start fee, charging fee, minute fee, and idle fee. Used to manage and fine-tune pricing behavior for charging sessions.
terms.usageRules: Use additional fee in lowercase in running text. Do not abbreviate or shorten. Avoid using interchangeably with price or tariff - these refer to separate pricing structures. Use consistently when describing extra costs applied on top of a base rate in Hub.

translations.grammarNotes: N | acc sg: viðbótargjald | nom pl: viðbótargjöld

terms.description: Description: A user role in Monta Hub with full access to account management, permissions, and organizational configurations for Business plan users.
terms.usageRules: Capitalize Admin when referring to the specific user role (e.g., Admin role). Use lowercase (admin) when referring to a person performing the role in running text. Use consistently in Hub to describe users with full organizational access and control permissions.

translations.grammarNotes: M | acc sg: stjórnanda | nom pl: stjórnendur

terms.description: Description: A French government incentive program that supports the installation and expansion of EV charging infrastructure across France. Advenir provides financial aid to promote the adoption of electric mobility.
terms.usageRules: Always capitalize as a proper name ("Advenir"). Keep in French; do not translate or localize.

terms.description: Description: Acronym for Alternative Fuels Infrastructure Regulation, an EU regulation that establishes binding targets for the deployment of EV charging and refueling infrastructure across member states.
terms.usageRules: Always write in all caps: AFIR. On first mention, spell out the full name followed by the acronym in parentheses - Alternative Fuels Infrastructure Regulation (AFIR). Use the acronym alone (AFIR) after the first mention. Do not pluralize or translate. Use only in regulatory, compliance, or policy-related contexts relevant to EU infrastructure standards.

terms.description: Description: A system-generated notification that informs operators about important operational or device-related events, such as errors, outages, or failed charges. Alerts are automatically triggered when specific conditions or thresholds are met.
terms.usageRules: Use alert in lowercase in running text. Capitalize only when part of a UI label, menu item, or title (e.g., Alert Settings, New Alert). Do not use interchangeably with notification - alert refers to automated, event-driven system messages, while notification may include general updates or communications. Use consistently in contexts describing system logic, monitoring, or operator responses.

translations.grammarNotes: F | acc sg: tilkynningu | nom pl: tilkynningar

terms.description: Description: A configuration feature that allows users to organize and manage alerts for charge points, charging sites, or teams. Alert groups ensure that the appropriate people are notified when specific incidents or conditions occur.
terms.usageRules: Use alert group in lowercase in running text. Capitalize when referring to the feature name or in UI contexts (e.g., Alert Groups, Create Alert Group). Avoid using interchangeably with notification group or team alerts, alert group refers specifically to system-triggered operational events. Use only in contexts describing monitoring, alert management, or incident response settings.

translations.grammarNotes: M | acc sg: tilkynningahóp | nom pl: tilkynningahópar

terms.description: Description: An EU regulation that sets mandatory targets for member states to deploy accessible and interoperable alternative fuel infrastructure, including EV charging and refuelling stations. It aims to support the transition to sustainable mobility across the EU.
terms.usageRules: Use the full name Alternative Fuels Infrastructure Regulation on first mention, followed by the acronym in parentheses - Alternative Fuels Infrastructure Regulation (AFIR). Use AFIR alone in subsequent mentions. Keep capitalization exactly as in the official title. Do not translate or abbreviate further. Use only in contexts related to compliance, infrastructure deployment, or EU regulatory standards.

terms.description: Monta’s Public API allows end customers to integrate their Monta-connected charge points and EVs with any system to use the data. For example, triggering a home charge based on conditions like house meter or solar energy
terms.usageRules: Always write 'API' in all caps.

terms.description: Description: A unique identifier used to authenticate and validate a client’s identity when sending requests to the Monta API. It ensures secure communication between systems and prevents unauthorized access.
terms.usageRules: Always lowercase “key.” Write as “API key” (not “API Key”). Do not translate or localize the term “API.” Use the singular form unless referring to multiple credentials. Suitable for technical or developer-facing content only; avoid in consumer-facing copy.

translations.grammarNotes: M | acc sg: API-lykil | nom pl: API-lyklar

terms.description: Description: Lightweight Apple experience that lets iOS drivers start a charge or complete a quick action in Monta Charge without installing the full app.
terms.usageRules: Use “App Clips” (Apple’s official term). Translatable: Partial - FR Extrait d’app, FR_CA Extrait d’appli. Keep capitalization: Both words capitalized. Mention only when the experience differs from the full app. Do not equate with Shortcuts, Widgets, or Instant Apps. For Android, reference the equivalent “Instant Apps.”

terms.description: Description: Apple’s digital marketplace for downloading and updating iOS and iPadOS applications, including the Monta Charge app.
terms.usageRules: Keep capitalization as “App Store.” Do not translate or modify. Use the definite article when referring to it (“on the App Store”).

terms.description: LEGACY FORBIDDEN: use Outbound Roaming instead. Retired German translation — keep in English.
Description: Automatic top-up feature in the wallet > Refill section that adds funds when the balance reaches a defined threshold. Users can set the trigger amount and refill value.
terms.usageRules: Use lowercase. Always written as “auto refill” (two words). Use consistently with feature name in UI and documentation.

translations.grammarNotes: F | acc sg: sjálfvirka áfyllingu | nom pl: sjálfvirkar áfyllingar

terms.description: Description: Automatic monthly transfer feature in the wallet > Withdraw section that moves available funds to a linked bank account.
terms.usageRules: Capitalize only the first word in UI contexts (“Auto withdrawal”). Keep phrasing consistent with the in-app label.

translations.grammarNotes: K | acc sg: sjálfvirka millifærslu | nom pl: sjálfvirkar millifærslur

terms.description: Description: Monta feature that automatically starts a charging session when a registered EV is plugged into a compatible charge point.
terms.usageRules: Use sentence case for stand alone UI labels, beginning of the sentence. use lower case when in the running texts. Avoid short form auto, as it implies “car” Use only for describing this specific B2C feature.

translations.grammarNotes: F | acc sg: sjálfvirka hleðslu | nom pl: sjálfvirkar hleðslur

terms.description: Description: Remote collection of data from an electricity meter, where consumption data is recorded and made accessible to the service provider for monitoring and reporting.
terms.usageRules: Use lowercase. Prefer “automatic reading” over “auto reading.” Avoid abbreviations or rephrasing.

translations.grammarNotes: K | acc sg: sjálfvirka greiningu | nom pl: sjálfvirkar greiningar

terms.description: Description: Feature that enables a charge to begin automatically when an EV is plugged into a private charge point configured for AutoStart. Used in private and closed networks.
terms.usageRules: Use sentence case for stand alone UI labels, beginning of the sentence. Use lower case when in the running texts. Avoid short form auto, as it implies “car” Use only for describing this specific B2C feature

terms.description: Description: Status indicating that a charge point is online, connected, and ready for use.
terms.usageRules: Use lowercase in running text. Capitalize as a UI label ("Available"). Use only for charge point status, not for pricing or feature readiness.

terms.description: Description: The available amount of money in a user’s wallet within Monta, representing funds available for charging or withdrawals.
terms.usageRules: Use lowercase in text. In UI, display as “Balance.”

translations.grammarNotes: F | acc sg: innistæðu | nom pl: innistæður

terms.description: Description: The total amount of electrical energy a battery can store and deliver, typically measured in ampere-hours (Ah) or watt-hours (Wh). It represents the battery’s total storage potential.
terms.usageRules: Use lowercase. Prefer concise form (e.g., “battery capacity: 60 kWh”). Use only in technical or informative contexts.

translations.grammarNotes: K | acc sg: stærð rafhlöðu | nom pl: stærðir rafhlöðu

terms.description: Description: Field label showing the current battery percentage of an integrated vehicle, for example “Battery level: 78%.”
terms.usageRules: Use sentence case in UI ("Battery level").

translations.grammarNotes: K | acc sg: stöðu rafhlöðu | nom pl: stöður rafhlöðu

terms.description: Description: Monta Hub feature allowing operators to define and manage price agreements and access terms with eMSPs (Electric Mobility Service Providers), primarily for roaming partnerships.
terms.usageRules: Use lowercase unless referring to the specific Hub feature. Avoid abbreviation unless previously defined.

translations.grammarNotes: M | acc sg: tvíhliða samning | nom pl: tvíhliða samningar

terms.description: Description: Internal and operator-facing functionality that lets users create or update multiple assets or configurations in a single operation, instead of performing each action one by one.
terms.usageRules: Use as a noun (e.g. “run a bulk import,” “the Bulk Import flow”); avoid using it as a verb (“to bulk import”). Keep it singular; avoid “Bulk Imports” — use “bulk import operations” or “bulk import jobs” if you need to express plurality. Avoid using “Bulk Import” in B2C or driver-facing copy; it is intended for internal and operator contexts where technical, process-focused language is appropriate, while still staying clear and human.

translations.grammarNotes: M | acc sg: innlestur | nom pl: innlestur

terms.description: Description: Charge point status indicating that the hardware is currently in use or reserved. May include sub-states such as blocked, scheduled, or actively charging.
terms.usageRules: Use lowercase in text. In UI, display as “Busy.” Do not apply to people or teams.

terms.description:
escription:
 An OCPP-based method that enables a Charge Point Management System (CPMS) to communicate live pricing data, such as price per kWh, ongoing cost, and total cost, to a charge point during an active charging session. Originally developed to meet California’s transparency regulations, it is now widely adopted as a best-practice standard for real-time tariff display and cost calculation in EV charging.
terms.usageRules: Keep capitalization (“California Pricing”). Use the full term on first mention and include a brief explanation if context is technical. Do not translate or localize. Use only when referring to the specific OCPP-based functionality, not as a general description of regional or geographic pricing. Avoid abbreviating (e.g., “Cal Pricing”) or using as a generic label.

terms.description: Description: Italian billing compliance term used exclusively in Italy for legally recognized electronic communications between entities (geo-specific term). There is no equivalent in other locales; do descriptive translation.
terms.usageRules: Use lowercase. Apply only in Italian market and legal or billing contexts. Do not replace with “email” in other languages.

translations.grammarNotes: M | acc sg: rafrænan sendipóst | nom pl: rafrænir sendipóstar

terms.description: Description: Monta’s record of shipped product updates, feature releases, accessed in HUB, under “What’s new” side panel label, hosted by Beamer.
terms.usageRules: Capitalize “Changelog” when referring to the UI label; use lowercase in generic references.

translations.grammarNotes: F | acc sg: breytingaskrá | nom pl: breytingaskrár

terms.description: Description: Adjective. Used to describe a charging-related object, log, or record linked to a session or transaction. Examples: “charge log,” “charge ID,” “charge object.”
terms.usageRules: Always lowercase. Use only as a descriptive modifier. Avoid using where “charging” is the more natural form for localization.

terms.description: Description: Monta’s mobile app for EV drivers to find, start, schedule, and pay for charging sessions.
terms.usageRules: Reduce combination “Monta Charge” It is redundant and hardcoded for white label partners. Do not translate, pluralize. Uninflected across all languages, treated as brand-like identifiers. Use “charging app” only when referring to a generic category.

translations.grammarNotes: F | acc sg: ON Hleðslu

terms.description: Description: Noun. The event or session during which an EV is connected to a charge point and receives electricity until completion.
terms.usageRules: Use “charge” to describe the session event. Do not use “charge” alone to mean fee or payment. Keep lowercase except in proper nouns (e.g., Charge History).

translations.grammarNotes: F | acc sg: hleðslu | nom pl: hleðslur

terms.description: Description: Verb. To supply electricity to an EV using a charge point or compatible setup.
terms.usageRules: Use only for the energy transfer process, not payment. In UI, use imperative form (“Charge now”). In documentation, use infinitive (“to charge an EV”). Lowercase unless at sentence start or part of a product name.

terms.description: Description: A header label in the Me section of the Charge app that displays a user’s charging logs, including energy delivered (kWh), charge point name, and total cost.
terms.usageRules: Use sentence case in running text ("charge history"). Capitalize only the first word as a UI label ("Charge history"). Do not use plural form — always "Charge history".

translations.grammarNotes: F | acc sg: hleðslusögu | nom pl: hleðslusögur

terms.description: Description: A physical device (RFID card or fob) used to identify a user or team and authorize charging on compatible charge points.
terms.usageRules: Use “charge key” in consumer-facing and support content. Use “RFID card” or “RFID tag” in technical, integration, or API documentation. Lowercase in running text unless used in a UI label (e.g., “Charge Key Settings”).

translations.grammarNotes: M | acc sg: ON lykill| nom pl: ON lyklar

terms.description: Description: The maximum battery level to which an electric vehicle (EV) is charged during a session, usually defined by the user or the vehicle’s system.
terms.usageRules: Always lowercase (“charge limit”). Use “charge limit” in text and labels. Express as a percentage (%) in UI when shown numerically.

translations.grammarNotes: N | acc sg: hleðslumörk | nom pl: hleðslumörk

terms.description:
B2C (Charge mobile app): preferred driver-facing term for EV charging hardware — use for the hardware unit or outlet from the driver's perspective.

B2B: do not use — use "charging station" for the full hardware unit, or "EVSE" for the outlet/connector level.

Replaces previous use of "charger" for B2C context.

Platform: Charge (mobile app) — B2C only
Audience: B2C (drivers, consumers)
terms.usageRules: Use lowercase in running text ('charge point'). Capitalize only the first word as a UI label ('Charge point'). Preferred B2C term (Charge app) for charging hardware; use 'charging station' in B2B frontends.

translations.grammarNotes: F | acc sg: hleðlustöðina | nom pl: hleðlustöðvar

terms.description: Description: Software platform used by operators to monitor, manage, and optimize EV charging infrastructure, including connectivity, pricing, access, reporting, and integrations.
terms.usageRules: Use the full term “charge point management system” in general or product-facing copy. Introduce abbreviation “CPMS” in technical documentation after first mention. Do not use “CSMS.” When referring to Monta’s system, use “Monta Hub.”

terms.description: Description: Entity that owns, operates, and maintains EV charge points or networks. In Monta’s ecosystem, operators are classified as Partners, with dedicated features supporting their operations.
terms.usageRules: Use lowercase (“charge point operator”) unless abbreviated. Reduce usage of abbrev., unless well-established. Introduce the abbreviation “CPO” on first mention, then use consistently thereafter. Keep consistent with industry usage and avoid shortening to “operator” alone.

translations.grammarNotes: M | acc sg: rekstraraðila hleðslustöðva | nom pl: rekstraraðilar hleðslustöðva

terms.description: Description: Amount of electrical power delivered from the charge point to the EV at a given moment, measured in kilowatts (kW).
terms.usageRules: Use for live or measured performance data (telemetry, dashboards, analytics). Do not confuse with “charged energy” (kWh). Format units as lowercase “kW” with a non-breaking space (e.g., “11 kW”). Use “charging speed” in consumer-facing or simplified copy.

translations.grammarNotes: N | acc sg: hleðsluafl | nom pl: hleðsluafl

terms.description: Description: The total price accumulated during a charging session, including components such as price per kWh, per minute, or membership rates.
terms.usageRules: Always lowercase (“charge price”). Do not shorten to “price” when referring to session cost. Differentiate clearly from configuration or tariff setup prices in Hub.

translations.grammarNotes: N | acc sg: hleðsluverð | nom pl: hleðsluverð

terms.description:
FORBIDDEN — do not use in any product.

Replaced by surface-specific terms:

B2C copy (Charge mobile app):
• Hardware unit or outlet → "charge point"

B2B copy (Hub, Control Tower, Installer, Operator Portal):
• Physical device at a site → "charging station"
• Individual outlet or connector on a station → "EVSE"

translations.grammarNotes: F | acc sg: hleðlustöð | nom pl: hleðlustöðvar

terms.description: Description: UI label on the Charge app home screen linking to the list or map of available charging locations.
terms.usageRules: Always use Title Case (“Chargers”). Always plural, never singular. Do not replace with “Charge points,” “Stations,” or “Sites.”

translations.grammarNotes: F | acc sg: hleðslustöðvar | nom pl: hleðslustöðvar

terms.description: Description: Adjective. Describes states, processes, or attributes related to an ongoing charge. Examples: “charging session,” “charging port,” “charging time.”
terms.usageRules: Always lowercase (“charging”). Use only as a modifier (adjective). Avoid redundancy when the context already implies charging (e.g., “charging session” → not “EV charging session”).

terms.description: Description: Noun. The act or process of supplying electricity to an EV battery via a charge point.
terms.usageRules: Always lowercase (“charging”). Use for general or conceptual process descriptions. Do not confuse with “charge” (noun), which refers to a specific session or transaction. Avoid when referring to a single event — use “charge session” instead.

translations.grammarNotes: F | acc sg: hleðslu | nom pl: hleðslur

terms.description: Description: Generic term for mobile applications that enable EV drivers to find, start, schedule, and pay for charging sessions.
terms.usageRules: Use “charging app” only when referring to the category of EV charging applications. Never use in UI, use “Monta Charge” when referring specifically to Monta’s product. Keep lowercase in running text. May be used in comparative or educational contexts (e.g., “Unlike other charging apps…”).

translations.grammarNotes: N | acc sg: hleðsluforrit | nom pl: hleðsluforrit

terms.description: Description: A cable that connects an electric vehicle to a charge point to transfer electricity for charging.
terms.usageRules: Use “charging cable” in documentation, help content, and marketing materials. In UI, use the short form “Cable” when context is clear. Do not abbreviate (avoid “EV cable” or “CP cable”). Differentiate clearly from connector (plug) and charge point (hardware).

translations.grammarNotes: M | acc sg: hleðslukapal | nom pl: hleðslukaplar

terms.description: Description: A feature within the Charge Subscription plan that allows users to apply a discount to charging sessions.
terms.usageRules: Use lowercase in running text ('charging discount'). Capitalize only the first word as a UI label ('Charging discount'). Avoid 'charge' as it can imply 'fee'. Use only when describing product features or subscription benefits.

translations.grammarNotes: M | acc sg: hleðsluafslátt | nom pl: hleðsluafslættir

terms.description: Description: A fee type applied during a charging session after a specified time threshold, e.g., DKK 50,00 added after 60 minutes of charging.
terms.usageRules: Always lowercase (“charging fee”). Use in documentation or UI where the fee condition is defined. Always specify timing or application condition.

translations.grammarNotes: N | acc sg: hleðslugjald | nom pl: hleðslugjöld

terms.description: Description: The instantaneous rate at which electrical energy is transferred or used during charging. Expressed in kilowatts (kW).
terms.usageRules: Use lowercase in running text ('charging power'). Preferred terms: 'power' or 'charging power'. Avoid 'charging speed' in technical UI; reserve it for consumer-friendly copy only if needed.

translations.grammarNotes: N | acc sg: hleðsluafl | nom pl: hleðsluafl

terms.description: Description: Feature in the Charge app allowing users to pre-define charge schedules when plugging into a private charge point, automating repetitive home-charging actions.
terms.usageRules: Always lowercase (“charging rule”). Mention only in relation to the scheduling functionality within the app. Do not use as a synonym for “policy” or “restriction.”

translations.grammarNotes: F | acc sg: hleðslustillingu | nom pl: hleðslustillingar

terms.description: Description: Plan that defines when an EV should start or stop charging, enabling users to optimize for energy cost or grid demand. Managed via the Schedule feature in the Charge app.
terms.usageRules: Always lowercase (“charging schedule”). Prefer “Schedule” when referring to the UI feature name. Use the full phrase in documentation or support contexts for clarity.

translations.grammarNotes: F | acc sg: tímasetta hleðslu | nom pl: tímasettar hleðslur

terms.description: Description: The duration in which an EV is connected to a charge point and receiving power until the session ends.
terms.usageRules: Always lowercase (“charge session”). Prefer “charge session” over “charge” alone for clarity in UI and documentation. Maintain consistency across reports, app logs, and analytics dashboards.

translations.grammarNotes: F | acc sg: hleðslulotu | nom pl: hleðslulotur

terms.description:
LEGACY FORBIDDEN: do not use "charging site" to refer to a charging location.

Replaced by: "location" in all Hub, Control, and operator product copy.
Description: The rate at which an EV battery gains energy during charging, expressed as power (kW) or estimated time to charge.
terms.usageRules: Always lowercase (“charging speed”). Use in consumer or marketing contexts. Use “charge power (kW)” for technical accuracy or live telemetry data. Do not confuse with “charging time” (duration).

translations.grammarNotes: M | acc sg: hleðsluhraða | nom pl: hleðsluhraðar

terms.description: Description: The hardware-level unit at a site that hosts one or more EVSEs. The physical enclosure or device that supplies charging infrastructure — a single charging station may have multiple outlets (EVSEs), each serving one vehicle at a time.
terms.usageRules: Use in all B2B monorepo frontends (Hub, Control, Installer, portals). Do not use in the Charge mobile app (B2C) — hardware level is not exposed to drivers; use "charge point" instead. A charging station contains one or more EVSEs. Do not use as a synonym for EVSE. Replaces ambiguous use of "charge point" at the hardware level. Example: a HYC400 with two outlets = one charging station with two EVSEs.

translations.grammarNotes: F | acc sg: hleðslustöðina | nom pl: hleðslustöðvar

terms.description: Description: Label for the communication feature within Monta used to exchange messages between users, charge point owners, or Monta Support. “Chat” can refer to both the in-app messaging tool and its associated action (to chat).
terms.usageRules: Always capitalize (“Chat”) when referring to the product feature or UI label. Use lowercase (“chat”) when referring to the action (e.g., “chat with support”). Use consistently across Charge for user-to-user and support communication.

translations.grammarNotes: N | acc sg: spjall | nom pl: spjöll

terms.description: Description: A private key used in Monta’s API authentication (OAuth 2.0). It identifies and authenticates a client application (such as a partner integration) to the Monta API securely, ensuring only authorized systems can access protected data.
terms.usageRules: Always lowercase (“client secret”). Use only in technical and developer documentation. Use alongside related terms like “client ID” and “API key.”

translations.grammarNotes: N | acc sg: lykilorð | nom pl: lykilorð

terms.description: Description: A vehicle provided by an employer for business or mixed (business and personal) use. In Monta, Company Car agreements link employees’ charging sessions to their employer’s Monta Wallet. Work-related charges are automatically reimbursed, and wallet reconciliation is managed through the Company Car reimbursement flow.
terms.usageRules: Use lowercase (“company car”) in text. Use only in fleet or reimbursement-related contexts.

translations.grammarNotes: M | acc sg: fyrirtækjabíl | nom pl: fyrirtækjabílar

terms.description: Description: A legal business identifier assigned to a company in its country of registration. In Monta, this number is required for business account setup, billing, and regulatory compliance within the EU and UK.
terms.usageRules: Use lowercase (“company registration number”). Do not abbreviate (avoid “CRN”). Use in forms, billing flows, and verification processes.

translations.translation: numero di iscrizione al registro delle imprese

translations.grammarNotes: F | acc sg: kennitölu fyrirtækis | nom pl: kennitölur fyrirtækja

terms.description: Description: Verb used when a charge point or external system establishes a link with Monta software, either via OCPP (Open Charge Point Protocol), Partner API, or physical plug-in connection by a driver.
terms.usageRules: Always lowercase (“connect”). Use as a verb in product copy (e.g., “Connect a charge point to Monta”). Avoid as a noun (do not use “connection” unless describing a network state).

terms.description: Description: The physical interface (socket or cable end) that connects the electric vehicle (EV) to the charge point. Supported connector types in Monta include Type 2, CCS, Type 1, CHAdeMO, and others. Each connector is tracked individually for status, pricing, and reporting in Monta Hub.
terms.usageRules: Always lowercase (“connector”) in running text. Use singular or plural as context requires. Distinguish clearly from “cable” (the wire) and “port” (the vehicle inlet).

translations.grammarNotes: N | acc sg: tengi | nom pl: tengi

terms.description: Description: Defines the actual cost of electricity for an operator or team. A cost group represents what the operator pays (the “cost price”) rather than what is charged to end users (the “sale price”). Cost groups are used for internal reporting, budgeting, and profitability analysis - not for payments or transactions.
terms.usageRules: Always lowercase in running text ("cost group"). Capitalize only the first word as a UI label ("Cost group").

translations.grammarNotes: M | acc sg: verðflokk | nom pl: verðflokkar

terms.description: Description: Acronym for Charge Point - the hardware device providing EV charging. In Monta documentation, “charge point” is preferred for clarity, especially in English. Each charge point can have multiple connectors and be linked to teams, sites, or operators.
terms.usageRules: . Use “CP” only after introducing the full term (“Charge Point (CP)”). Use only in technical documentation or developer contexts. Prefer “charge point” over “CP” in UI, marketing, or consumer-facing content.

terms.description: Description: An acronym for Charge Point Integration, which enables communication and data exchange between charging stations and central management systems or external platforms. It supports data flow, status updates, and control signals across connected systems.
terms.usageRules: Always capitalize the acronym “CPI.” Spell out “Charge Point Integration (CPI)” on first mention in documentation or long-form content. Use only in technical or integration-related contexts; avoid in high-level customer-facing copy. Do not use as a replacement for specific protocols or standards (e.g., OCPP) when those are meant.

terms.description: Description: Acronym for Charge Point Management System. In Monta’s context, this refers to Monta Hub, the central platform used by operators and partners to manage charge points, sites, users, pricing, and operational workflows.
terms.usageRules: Always capitalize “CPMS.” Spell out “Charge Point Management System (CPMS)” on first mention. Prefer “Monta Hub” when referring to Monta’s own CPMS, but it can be used to describe comparable systems. Do not shorten to “management system.”

Système de gestion des bornes de recharge
SGSÎ (Sistemul de Gestionare al Stației de Încărcare)

terms.description: Description: Abbreviation for Charge Point Operator, the entity responsible for operating, maintaining, and managing EV charge points or sites. In Monta, CPOs use Monta Hub to manage their network, set pricing, monitor uptime, and integrate with payment systems.
terms.usageRules: Always capitalize when referring to this role or partner type. Introduce abbreviation “CPO” in parentheses after first mention and use consistently thereafter. Avoid using “operator” alone when referring to this entity.

terms.description: Description: Non-withdrawable funds stored in a team wallet, used to pay for Monta-related transactions such as charging sessions, subscriptions, or fees. Credits can be earned through referrals, promotions, or PowerBank participation and are tracked separately from withdrawable wallet balances.
terms.usageRules: Use lowercase “credit” in running text. Use plural “credits” when referring to multiple units. Do not confuse with “wallet balance” or “withdrawable funds.” Use only when referring to non-withdrawable wallet funds.

translations.grammarNotes: F | acc sg: inneign | nom pl: inneignir

terms.description: Description: A financial document issued to correct or reduce the amount of a previously issued invoice, typically due to returns, adjustments, or billing errors. In Monta, credit notes appear in the Finance section of Hub and are automatically linked to the original invoice.
terms.usageRules: Use lowercase “credit note” in running text. Use plural “credit notes” for multiple documents. Do not shorten to “note” alone. Use only in billing and finance contexts.

translations.grammarNotes: F | acc sg: kvittun | nom pl: kvittanir

terms.description: Description: A Current Transformer (CT) clamp is a device used to measure electrical current flowing through a conductor without direct contact. In Monta, CT clamps are used in Smart Meter and Load Balancing setups to provide real-time current measurements from a site’s main fuse or solar installation. These readings help Monta’s CPI service optimize charging based on available power.
terms.usageRules: Spell out on first mention: “Current Transformer (CT) clamp.” Use abbreviation “CT clamp” thereafter. Keep “CT” capitalized as it is a technical abbreviation. Use only in technical or installer-facing documentation.

translations.grammarNotes: F | acc sg: CT-klemmu | nom pl: CT-klemmur

terms.description: Description: The flow of electric charge that powers an EV during charging. Monta supports both Alternating Current (AC) and Direct Current (DC) charging, depending on the charge point hardware and configuration. Current type affects charging speed and connector compatibility.
terms.usageRules: Use lowercase “current” in running text. Use “AC” and “DC” in uppercase when referring to current types. Avoid using in isolation in UI; specify type where relevant (e.g., “AC current”).

translations.grammarNotes: M | acc sg: straum | nom pl: straumar

terms.description: Description: A feature in Monta Hub that allows charge point operators or service providers to create tailored subscription plans for their clients. These plans can include services such as charge point operation, maintenance, leasing, software access, or tax refund management. End users are billed monthly through Monta, and payments are handled via the Wallet and Subscriptions modules.
terms.usageRules: Use lowercase in running text unless appearing as a feature name or UI label. Avoid shortening to “subscription” when referring to custom plans. Use only in Hub contexts related to service management.

translations.grammarNotes: F | acc sg: þína áskrift | nom pl: þínar áskriftir

terms.description: Description: A Monta specialist responsible for onboarding new business users, ensuring successful adoption of Monta’s platform, and supporting long-term account growth. Customer Success Managers (CSMs) proactively assist partners (CPOs, installers, or enterprises) to achieve operational success and maximize value from Monta Hub and related services.
terms.usageRules: Use lowercase in running text; capitalize when referring to a specific title (e.g., “Your Customer Success Manager will contact you”). Introduce abbreviation “CSM” after first mention and use consistently. Use only for Monta internal and partner-facing roles.

translations.grammarNotes: M | acc sg: þjónustufulltrúa | nom pl: þjónustufulltrúar

terms.description: The analytics section in Monta Hub where operators access embedded reports, the Control Tower overview, and custom Studio dashboards.
terms.usageRules: Capitalise as a navigation label and page title: "Dashboards" Use lowercase in running text: "no dashboards available", "select a dashboard" Singular "Dashboard" refers to an individual view within the section B2B-only — not used in the Charge (B2C) driver app

terms.description: Description: B2B feature in Monta Hub that allows operators to discover, connect, and monitor managed data-sharing integrations with external systems. Data Pipelines automate the secure delivery of static and dynamic data to endpoints such as National Access Points (NAPs), AFIR compliance systems, rebate programs, and other partner or regulatory platforms.
terms.usageRules: Sentence case capitalization “Data pipelines” when referring to the Hub feature or UI label. Use lowercase “data pipelines” in general descriptions. Avoid shortening to “pipelines” without context. Use only in data integration or compliance contexts.

terms.description: Description: Monta’s centralized, cloud-based data storage and analytics system that enables sharing of operational and performance data with partners through secure integrations or embedded dashboards. It supports advanced analytics, exports, and visualization features such as Tableau dashboards, data pipelines, and API feeds.
terms.usageRules: Do not translate, except for fr_CA Use only when referring to Monta’s internal or partner-accessible data infrastructure. Avoid using as a synonym for “database.”

translations.grammarNotes: M | acc sg: Gagnagrunn | nom pl: Gagnagrunnar

terms.description: Description: A Monta product add-on available for partner and operator subscriptions. Data+ unlocks enhanced data capabilities such as advanced analytics, detailed charge point performance insights, extended data retention, or additional integrations beyond the standard Monta Hub plan.
terms.usageRules: Always write as “Data+” with the plus sign included. Uninflected across all languages, treated as brand-like identifiers. Capitalize “D” and retain the symbol across all languages. Use only when referring to the paid add-on module. Do not translate, except for fr_CA

terms.description: Description: Type of charging using Direct Current (DC), delivering higher power outputs than AC (Alternating Current). DC charge points enable fast and ultra-fast charging, typically located at public charging parks or highways.
terms.usageRules: Always capitalize “DC” and “AC.” Use “DC charge point,” not “DC unit” in customer-facing copy.

terms.description: Description: A unique URL that connects directly to a specific charge point or related page, enabling EV drivers to start charging by scanning a QR code or NFC tag. In Monta Hub, the Deeplinks feature allow Solution Providers to create, link, and manage deeplinks remotely.
terms.usageRules: Capitalize “Deeplink” when referring to the Hub feature name. Use lowercase “deeplink” when referring to an individual link or general concept. Use plural “deeplinks” when describing multiple URLs. Use only in contexts involving charge point access, QR/NFC integration, or Solution Provider workflows. Avoid abbreviations (e.g., “DL”) or replacing with “link.”

terms.description: Description: A smart charging scheduling option that allows users to postpone the start of a charging session. When enabled, the session begins automatically at the optimal or user-defined time, usually to align with lower energy prices or grid-friendly charging windows.
terms.usageRules: Use lowercase in running text ("delayed start"). Use sentence case in UI labels or menu items ("Delayed start").

translations.grammarNotes: F | acc sg: seinkaða hleðslu | nom pl: seinkaðar hleðslur

terms.description: Description: Noun, funds added to a user’s or team’s Monta Wallet and made available for payments or transactions such as charging, or subscriptions. Deposits are withdrawable.
terms.usageRules: Use lowercase “deposit” in running text. Use plural “deposits” when referring to multiple transactions. Avoid confusing with “credit” or “top-up.”

translations.grammarNotes: F | acc sg: innborgun | nom pl: innborganir

terms.description: Description: A Distribution System Operator (DSO) manages and maintains the local electricity distribution grid that delivers power from transmission systems to end users. In Monta’s context, DSOs are external stakeholders in grid-service integrations such as PowerBank, Smart Charging, and Load Management, where real-time load data or flexibility services may be exchanged.
terms.usageRules: Spell out on first mention: “distribution system operator (DSO).” Use abbreviation “DSO” thereafter. Use only in energy, grid, or flexibility contexts.

translations.grammarNotes: F | acc sg: dreifiveitu | nom pl: dreifiveitur

terms.description: A Monta feature that enables charge point operators to offer a dedicated support channel to drivers experiencing issues with charging sessions, charge points, or their accounts. Support can be handled directly by Monta or delegated to the operator.
terms.usageRules: Always write "Driver Support" with capital D and S when referring to the feature by name. Use lowercase ("driver support") only when describing the concept generically, not the Monta feature. Do not abbreviate. Do not confuse with general Monta customer support — this refers specifically to the operator-configured support channel available to drivers within the Monta app. Acceptable in both UI labels and documentation.

translations.grammarNotes: F | acc sg: hleðsluaðstoð | nom pl: hleðsluaðstoð

terms.description: Description: Abbreviation for Distribution System Operator. See distribution system operator (DSO) for the full definition.
terms.usageRules: Always write 'DSO' in all caps. Spell out 'distribution system operator' on first mention.

terms.description: Description: A load management method that dynamically allocates available electrical power between multiple charge points in real time, based on total site consumption. Dynamic Load Balancing ensures grid limits are respected while optimizing charging speed for connected EVs. It relies on external meters such as CT clamps or smart meters to measure total consumption and continuously adjust power distribution.
terms.usageRules: Use lowercase in running text ("dynamic load balancing"). Use sentence case when referring to the Hub feature name or label ("Dynamic load balancing"). Do not truncate or abbreviate.

translations.grammarNotes: K | acc sg: breytilega álagsstýringu | nom pl: breytilega álagsstýringar

terms.description: Description: A price group type where the base (master) price follows the spot market price for electricity. Dynamic pricing fluctuates with market rates and can include operator-defined markups or limits. Used by CPOs to align charging prices with real-time energy costs.
terms.usageRules: Use lowercase “dynamic price” in running text. Use “dynamic pricing” when referring to the broader pricing method. Use only in pricing or energy cost configuration contexts.

translations.grammarNotes: F | acc sg: verðlagningu | nom pl: verðlagningar

terms.description: Description: A company that offers charging services to drivers via apps, subscriptions, or roaming networks, including account creation, authentication, and billing. In Monta, an e-mobility service provider connects driver access with charging networks for pricing, payments, and roaming.
terms.usageRules: Spell as “e-mobility service provider” (hyphen after “e”). Use sentence case in running text. Introduce abbreviation on first mention: “e-mobility service provider (eMSP)”; use “eMSP” thereafter. Article: “an eMSP.” Plural: “eMSPs.” Use when referring to the driver-facing service entity; do not use when you mean the infrastructure operator—use “Charge Point Operator (CPO)” instead. In UI and configuration (e.g., roaming, partner type), use “eMSP” for brevity and consistency. Avoid alternatives like “mobility provider” or “charging provider” unless required by third-party naming.

terms.description: Description: Employer Identification Number (EIN): a 9-digit U.S. federal tax ID used to identify businesses.
terms.usageRules: Use only for U.S. entities. For non-U.S. markets, use the relevant term (e.g., VAT number, company registration number). Avoid generic “tax number” or “company number” when referring to U.S. EINs to maintain consistency.

terms.description: LEGACY FORBIDDEN: use Inbound Roaming instead. Retired German translation — keep in English.
General term, indicating electricity costs. Applied for pricing setting.
terms.usageRules: Use lowercase in running text ('electricity costs'). Capitalize only the first word as a UI label ('Electricity costs').

translations.grammarNotes: M | acc sg: raforkukostnað | nom pl: raforkukostnaðir

terms.description: Description: The amount charged to drivers for consumed energy, expressed as a per-kWh rate. In Monta, it’s the energy component of a charging session price, separate from time fees or fixed session fees.
terms.usageRules: Use when referring specifically to the per-kWh part of the price; for the full amount a driver pays, use “charging price” or “total price.” In UI, label as “Energy price (per kWh)”; avoid “power price.” Singular by default (“electricity price”); use plural (“electricity prices”) only when comparing multiple sites or tariffs. Do not use for utility tariffs; prefer “energy tariff” or “utility tariff” when referring to supplier rates.

translations.grammarNotes: N | acc sg: raforkuverð | nom pl: raforkuverð

terms.description: Description: A Danish government scheme that reimburses private EV owners for the electricity tax paid on home charging, provided charging is metered and handled via an approved subscription or provider.
terms.usageRules: Use lowercase in running text ('electricity tax refund'). Use descriptive translation for languages other than Danish — this is a Denmark-specific concept. Avoid using as a synonym for 'reimbursement'.

terms.description: Description: A Danish government scheme that reimburses private EV owners for the electricity tax paid on home charging, provided charging is metered and handled via an approved subscription or provider.
terms.usageRules: Use lowercase in running text. Use descriptive translation for languages other than Danish — this is a Denmark-specific concept. Avoid using as a synonym for 'reimbursement'.

translations.grammarNotes: F | acc sg: endurgreiðslu raforkugjalds | nom pl: endurgreiðslur raforkugjalds

terms.description: An e-Mobility Service Provider (eMSP) is a company or platform that gives EV drivers access to public and private charge points across multiple networks through a single app, card, or account.
terms.usageRules: Write as 'eMSP' — lowercase 'e', uppercase 'MSP'. Always use this mixed-case form; do not modify. On first mention, write 'e-mobility service provider (eMSP)'; use 'eMSP' thereafter.

terms.description: Description: The timestamp when a charging session, schedule, or reservation finishes. In Monta, it marks the close of a time range paired with a start time for reporting, pricing, and availability.
terms.usageRules: Use lowercase in running text ('end time'). Capitalize only as a UI label ('End time'). Avoid synonyms like 'finish time' or 'stop time' in customer-facing copy; keep 'end time' consistent across surfaces.

translations.grammarNotes: M | acc sg: lokatíma | nom pl: lokatímar

terms.description: Description: The amount of energy delivered during a charging session, expressed in kilowatt-hours (kWh).
terms.usageRules: Always lowercase (“charge amount”). Avoid using this term to refer to price, payment, or cost.

translations.grammarNotes: F | acc sg: orku | nom pl: orka

terms.description: Description: Electric vehicle (EV): a road vehicle powered fully or primarily by electricity from a battery. In Monta, used to identify the driver’s or fleet’s vehicle type for charging, pricing, and reporting.
terms.usageRules: Article: “an EV.” Plural: “EVs.” Always capitalize the abbreviation “EV.” Use sentence case for the full term in running text. Avoid redundant phrasing like “EV car”; prefer “EV” or “vehicle.” Use “vehicle” (not “EV”) if the context already implies electric (e.g., within an EV-only list or filter). In UI labels and filters, use “EV” for brevity (e.g., “EV model,” “EV battery”);

translations.grammarNotes: M | acc sg: rafbíl | nom pl: rafbílar

terms.description: Description: The outlet-level entity within a charging station — a single supply unit that manages one charging session at a time. One EVSE may have multiple connectors (sockets or cable ends), but only one EV can be actively charged per EVSE at once. Refers to the hardware that controls and meters energy delivery and communicates via OCPP.
terms.usageRules: Use in all B2B monorepo frontends (Hub, Control, Installer, portals) when referring to individual outlets or supply units within a charging station. Do not use in the Charge mobile app (B2C) — use "charger" instead. EVSE is not a synonym for "charging station". A charging station contains one or more EVSEs. Do not replace EVSE with "charge point" — that term is forbidden. Example: a HYC400 with two outlets = one charging station with two EVSEs.

terms.description: Description: US-centric, a government-imposed tax on specific goods or energy use in the US. A tax imposed during EV charging in the US. No direct tax directive is applicable in EU.
terms.usageRules: Do not use for VAT, sales tax, grid fees, or levies—name those specifically. Do not use as a synonym for “surcharge” or “fee.” Keep terminology consistent across pricing, reporting, and exports.

translations.grammarNotes: N | acc sg: vörugjald | nom pl: vörugjöld

terms.description: Description: A mode that defaults to a safe state when a component, signal, or process fails.
terms.usageRules: Spell with a hyphen: “fail-safe.” Do not use “failsafe” or “fail safe.” Use lowercase in running text; Sentence in labels or headings. Can be an adjective (“fail-safe mode”) or a countable noun (“a fail-safe”). Plural: “fail-safes.”

translations.grammarNotes: F | acc sg: öryggisvillu | nom pl: öryggisvillur

terms.description: Description: Concept to benchmark good/bad market price on a public charge point for end-users. A filtering option in Maps in Charge app.
terms.usageRules: Use lowercase in running text: “fair price.” Do not capitalize or abbreviate.

translations.grammarNotes: N | acc sg: markaðsverð | nom pl: markaðsverð

terms.description: Description: A default price applied automatically when the intended tariff or price source is unavailable. The fallback price ensures sessions can be billed when normal pricing cannot be resolved.
terms.usageRules: Use lowercase in running text: “fallback price.” In UI labels and settings, use “Fallback price.” Avoid synonyms like “backup price” or “base price”; keep terminology consistent with “fallback price.”

translations.grammarNotes: N | acc sg: grunnverð | nom pl: grunnverð

terms.description: Description: A monetary amount added to a charging session that is not the per-kWh energy price or a tax. In Monta, fees cover extras such as a fixed session fee, a per-minute time fee, or other operator-defined charges.
terms.usageRules: Plural: “fees.” Article: “a fee.” In UI labels and settings, capitalize as “Fee,” and name the type explicitly (e.g., “Session fee,” “Time fee”). Avoid vague terms like “extra charge” or “surcharge”; name the fee type.

translations.grammarNotes: N | acc sg: gjald | nom pl: gjöld

terms.description: Description: A time-based fee charged for each minute of a charging session or an idle period. In Monta, it’s configured by operators and applied alongside the per-kWh energy price when enabled.
terms.usageRules: Use for time-based pricing during charging or after a grace period (idle). Do not use for energy consumption—use “energy price (per kWh).” Distinguish from “session fee” (fixed amount). Name the exact fee type in customer-facing copy. Article: “a per-minute fee.” Plural: “per-minute fees.” Do not abbreviate.

translations.grammarNotes: N | acc sg: gjald á mínútu | nom pl: gjöld á mínútu

terms.description: Description: A add-on subscription plan that extends billing, settlements, and reporting with advanced features (e.g., automated invoicing, payouts/reconciliation, and accounting exports)
terms.usageRules: Write exactly as “Finance+” (capital F, plus sign, no space). Do not use “Finance Plus” or “Finance Plus+.” Do not abbreviate. Pluralize only when referring to subscriptions or entitlements (e.g., “Finance+ subscriptions”). Use only for the Monta product/plan component.

terms.description: Description: embedded software on charging hardware that provides low-level control and enables communication with Monta (e.g., via OCPP). In Monta, firmware affects safety checks, metering, connector control, and interoperability.
terms.usageRules: Use lowercase in running text: “firmware.” No abbreviation. Prefer precise collocations: “firmware update,” “firmware version,” “firmware release.” Plurals: use “firmware versions” (not “firmwares”)

translations.grammarNotes: M | acc sg: hugbúnað | nom pl: hugbúnaðir

terms.description: Description: A static charging tariff you set either per kWh or per minute. Unlike spot pricing, the rate remains constant until you change it.
terms.usageRules: - Use in pricing settings, tariffs, and documentation; mention “spot pricing” when comparing alternatives. Use without an article in UI labels; use “a Fixed Price tariff” in running text.

translations.grammarNotes: N | acc sg: verð | nom pl: verð

terms.description: Description: A business-managed group of vehicles supported by Monta for public and depot charging. Includes tools for planning, cost control, load management, and future V2G workflows.
terms.usageRules: - Use lowercase “fleet” in running text; capitalize only if part of a feature or stand alone UI label. Use for business-operated vehicle groups; do not use for personal driver groups. Do not confuse with “team” or “company” in Monta account structures.

translations.grammarNotes: M | acc sg: bílaflota | nom pl: bílaflotаr

terms.description: Description: Predictive estimates of charging demand, timing, or energy usage generated from historical and operational data. Used to plan schedules and reduce energy costs across sites.
terms.usageRules: - Use lowercase in running text; capitalize only when matching a UI label or report title. Use to describe predictive outputs, not commitments or reservations. Not a synonym for “schedule” or “booking.” No abbreviations; if used as a verb, write “to forecast.”

translations.grammarNotes: F | acc sg: spá | nom pl: spár

terms.description: Description: Funds represent the withdrawable monetary balance available in a Monta wallet. Funds can be transferred to a user’s private bank account through Monta’s integrated payout system.
terms.usageRules: Use lowercase “funds” in running text; capitalize only when matching an exact UI label. Use “balance” for the current amount; use “funds” when referring to the withdrawable money or movements. Plural noun; do not abbreviate. Avoid synonyms such as “credits” or “cash” in product copy.

translations.grammarNotes: F | acc sg: innistæðu | nom pl: innistæður

terms.description: Description: Limits charging so the site’s electrical fuse or circuit capacity is not exceeded. Managed through Monta load management to distribute power across charge points and prevent overloads or tripped fuses.
terms.usageRules: Do not abbreviate; avoid “fusing.”

translations.grammarNotes: N | acc sg: öryggi | nom pl: öryggi

terms.description: Description: A short period before or after a charging session during which a driver is not charged idle fees or overstay fees.
terms.usageRules: - Do not pluralize unless referring to multiple configurations (“grace periods”). Use only when referring to fee-free buffer time linked to a charging session. Avoid alternatives like “free time,” “buffer,” or “no-fee window.” If shown in UI, ensure the exact value is displayed (e.g., “5-minute grace period”)

translations.grammarNotes: M | acc sg: greiðslufrest | nom pl: greiðslufrestir

terms.description: Description: The external electricity network that supplies energy to Monta-connected sites and can receive energy in V2G setups. Monta coordinates charging (e.g., load balancing, PowerBank) to avoid overloads and support grid stability.
terms.usageRules: Use lowercase in running text ('grid'). Capitalize only as a UI label. Use for the public electricity network; for on-site wiring use 'installation'. Do not use as a synonym for 'utility' or 'DSO'.

translations.grammarNotes: N | acc sg: raforkukerfi | nom pl: raforkukerfi

terms.description: Description: Monta’s premium growth-focused subscription plan providing advanced management, automation, and analytics capabilities. Designed for operators and partners scaling beyond the Free plan to increase operational efficiency.
terms.usageRules: Write “Growth+” exactly with the plus sign; do not abbreviate. Refer to the plan as “the Growth+ plan” in running text; use the exact label in UI. Use only for the official subscription tier; do not generalize to promotions or discounts. Avoid synonyms like “Pro” or “Premium” unless officially renamed.

terms.description: Description: Physical charge points and connected electrical devices integrated with the Monta platform. Compatibility and performance rely on certified integrations and firmware that enable features such as load balancing, PowerBank, and SolarCharging.
terms.usageRules: Use lowercase in running text; capitalize only when part of a proper name or UI label. Use “charge point” for the EVSE; avoid generic “charger” when precision is needed.

translations.grammarNotes: M | acc sg: vélbúnað | nom pl: vélbúnaðir

terms.description: Description: Monta’s ability to work with any compatible charge point brand or model. Enables mixing and managing multiple hardware types in one setup without vendor lock-in.
terms.usageRules: Use “hardware agnostic” in sentence case in running text; capitalize only in headings or UI labels. Do not imply support for unsupported models; reference the certified hardware list where relevant. Not a partnership or endorsement claim.

terms.description: Description: A company that designs and produces EV charge points compatible with Monta via certified integrations and APIs. Manufacturers use Hub to support configuration, firmware workflows, and reliable communication.
terms.usageRules: Use lowercase in running text; capitalize only when part of a proper name (e.g., “ABB hardware manufacturer” → “ABB”). Not the same as a charge point operator (CPO) or installer; use the precise role. Pluralize as “hardware manufacturers”; do not abbreviate.

translations.grammarNotes: M | acc sg: vélbúnaðarframleiðanda | nom pl: vélbúnaðarframleiðendur

terms.description: Short-form brand name for Monta's self-service knowledge base, Help Centre. Used in navigation labels, menu items, and compact UI contexts where the full name "Help Centre" does not fit.
terms.usageRules: Always capitalise: "Help" Use only in UI navigation contexts (e.g. tab labels, menu items, footer links) Do not use as a synonym for "Support" or as a standalone verb When space allows, prefer the full form "Help Centre"

translations.grammarNotes: F | acc sg: Hjálp | nom pl: Hjálp

terms.description: Description: Monta’s self-service knowledge base with product guides, troubleshooting articles, and instructional videos. Enables users to resolve issues and learn features across Monta products.
terms.usageRules: Use the exact spelling “Help Centre” in the source (not “Help Center”); capitalize both words. Use for knowledge base and support content; avoid using as a synonym for “Support” or “Status page.” Use the exact label in links and buttons. Do not abbreviate.

translations.grammarNotes: F | acc sg: Hjálparmiðstöð | nom pl: Hjálparmiðstöðvar

terms.description: Description: A residential EV charge point connected to Charge. Enables private users to schedule charging, use features like SolarCharging or PowerBank, and monitor energy usage at home.
terms.usageRules: Use sentence case in running text; in technical contexts prefer “home charge point” for precision. Do not use for workplace or public chargers. Avoid using “charger” to refer to cables or adapters.

translations.grammarNotes: F | acc sg: heimahleðslustöð | nom pl: heimahleðslustöðvar

terms.description: Description: Charging an electric vehicle at a private residence using a Monta-connected home charge point via Charge. Supports scheduling, smart features (e.g., solar charging, smart charging, and session monitoring.
terms.usageRules: Use sentence case in running text (“home charging”); capitalize only in headings or UI labels. Use for private residential contexts; do not use for workplace or public charging. Use “home charger” or “home charge point” for the device; use “home charging” for the activity.

translations.grammarNotes: F | acc sg: heimahleðslu | nom pl: heimahleðslur

terms.description: Description: Monta’s residential energy management scope connecting devices like charge points, solar, smart meters, and heat pumps to optimize electricity use and self-consumption. Coordinates charging and home energy flows to reduce grid dependency.
terms.usageRules: Use sentence case (“home energy”) in running text; capitalize only in headings or UI labels. Use when describing the overall residential energy setup; name specific devices/features when needed. Avoid using as a product name unless labeled in UI; otherwise describe the capability.

translations.grammarNotes: N | acc sg: heimilisrafmagn | nom pl: heimilisrafmagn

terms.description: Description: A collective property management organization that operates shared residential charging for tenants or owners. Monta enables centralized access control, billing, and reporting across shared charge points.
terms.usageRules: Use sentence case in running text; capitalize only when part of a legal entity’s proper name. Use for multi-dwelling/shared residential contexts; not for single-family homes or commercial sites. Prefer “housing association” over “HOA” unless the local market requires that term.

translations.grammarNotes: N | acc sg: húsfélag | nom pl: húsfélög

terms.description: Description: Monta’s web platform for managing charge points, sites, teams, pricing, and operations at scale. Provides tools for analytics, subscriptions, automation, and financial workflows for professional operators.
terms.usageRules: Use the exact product name “Hub”; do not use “portal.” Uninflected across all languages, treated as brand-like identifier. Capitalize “Hub” in all references; avoid abbreviations.

translations.grammarNotes: M | acc sg: On Flota | nom pl: ON Flotar

terms.description: Description: A dedicated post-launch support phase for new partners or deployments focused on proactive monitoring, rapid issue resolution, and close cross-team collaboration. Ensures a stable rollout and optimal performance across Monta products.
terms.usageRules: Capitalize “Hypercare” when referring to the formal support phase. Reference the specific scope (products, SLAs, duration) when documented.

terms.description: Description: A standardized international bank account identifier used in Monta wallet to enable withdrawals, deposits, and automated payouts. Required to link a user or operator bank account for payment operations.

 Monta Hub feature that generates, manages, and distributes invoices for charging sessions and services — enabling operators to bill end-customers, team members, or third-party clients under their own brand.

terms.description: Description: Monta’s internal digital payment account for storing, managing, and transferring funds. Supports deposits, withdrawals, reimbursements, and automated payments for charging and subscriptions.
terms.usageRules: Use sentence case only in stand-alone UI labels and in the start of sentence, otherwise - lower case. Use “refill” for adding funds and “withdrawal” for moving funds out; avoid generic “top-up” if the UI uses “Refill.” Avoid using “wallet” as a synonym for balance or invoice.
